tools.name: Claude Native Scheduled Tasks
tools.oneLine: Built-in recurring tasks with push notifications. No code.
tools.best_for: An agent that reaches out on a schedule with zero setup.
tools.watch_out: Needs a paid Claude plan; time can drift at daylight-saving.
tools.history: Proven in the field — powers Eve's 5 PM check-in. No status change since first vetting.

tools.name: Twilio
tools.oneLine: The industry standard for real SMS, WhatsApp and voice.
tools.best_for: When an agent needs to actually text a person, two-way, worldwide.
tools.watch_out: US texting needs carrier registration; publicly reported breaches (2022 phishing, 2024 Authy) have since been remediated.
tools.history: Breach history reviewed and judged remediated. Trust held at 5.

tools.name: Resend
tools.oneLine: Modern, developer-first email with a hosted connector. Nothing to install.
tools.best_for: A clean, modern, agent-ready way to send email.
tools.watch_out: Email only; sending-domain DNS setup takes a few steps.
tools.history: SOC 2 and GDPR confirmed. Free tier steady at 3,000 emails/month.

tools.name: Postmark
tools.oneLine: Famous for landing mail in the inbox — use only the official package.
tools.best_for: When reaching the inbox reliably matters most.
tools.watch_out: In Sept 2025 a malicious npm copy named `postmark-mcp` secretly BCC'd every email to an attacker — install only Postmark's own official server (github.com/ActiveCampaign/postmark-mcp). Free tier is 100 emails/mo.
tools.history: Sept 2025: an impostor package was found in the wild. Official package pinned in the catalog.

tools.name: SendGrid
tools.oneLine: Huge-scale, battle-tested — but no official agent connector.
tools.best_for: High-volume sending on a proven platform.
tools.watch_out: No official connector; free tier is now a 60-day trial; not self-serve HIPAA; parent company (Twilio) has past breaches, since remediated.
tools.history: Downgraded to Caution when the permanent free tier became a trial.

tools.name: Slack
tools.oneLine: Post an agent's messages, alerts and approvals into channels and DMs.
tools.best_for: Putting an agent's output where a team already works.
tools.watch_out: Internal only; connector needs an internal or listed app.
tools.history: Official connector generally available since Feb 2026 — score raised on reliability.

tools.name: Tavily
tools.oneLine: The search layer most agent frameworks reach for first. Paste one key.
tools.best_for: Searching the web with the least setup and a real free tier.
tools.watch_out: Reportedly acquired in early 2026; draws on other providers, not its own index.
tools.history: Feb 2026 acquisition flagged as a watch item; re-check scheduled quarterly.

tools.name: Exa
tools.oneLine: Its own index, finding things by meaning rather than keywords.
tools.best_for: Finding the exact right thing by meaning, not keywords.
tools.watch_out: Pricier per search; needs a little tuning.
tools.history: SOC 2 and HIPAA confirmed. Well funded; no change since first vetting.

tools.name: Linkup
tools.oneLine: Privacy- and EU-minded search, easiest install, most generous free tier.
tools.best_for: EU compliance, privacy, or a bigger free allowance.
tools.watch_out: Youngest/smallest; a little vendor-longevity risk.
tools.history: Keeps no data by default — noted against their SOC 2 report.

tools.name: Perplexity
tools.oneLine: Returns ready-made cited answers, not just links.
tools.best_for: Cited, ready-to-use answers with a documented compliance posture.
tools.watch_out: DPA/BAA are Enterprise/sales; US-hosted; self-declared; token pricing.
tools.history: Human-verified 22 Jul 2026: compliance claims read in full and found self-declared.

tools.name: Mem0
tools.oneLine: A ready-to-use memory layer — no database to assemble yourself.
tools.best_for: Giving an agent memory without wiring up infrastructure.
tools.watch_out: Newer company; SOC 2 Type II still in progress.
tools.history: Audit-in-progress noted; will re-score when SOC 2 Type II lands.

tools.name: Zep
tools.oneLine: Tracks how facts change, so an agent knows what's true now.
tools.best_for: When facts change over time (preferences, statuses).
tools.watch_out: Small/early-stage; self-hosted version retired.
tools.history: Cost score lowered when the free self-hosted tier was retired.

tools.name: Pinecone
tools.oneLine: The most turnkey vector database. Fully managed and certified.
tools.best_for: A rock-solid managed vector store to build memory on.
tools.watch_out: It's a database, not a memory layer; reportedly weighing a sale.
tools.history: SOC 2, ISO and HIPAA confirmed. Possible sale flagged as a watch item.

tools.name: Weaviate
tools.oneLine: Feature-rich open-source vector database, strong at scale.
tools.best_for: A feature-rich open-source vector DB, strong at scale.
tools.watch_out: No permanent free managed tier.
tools.history: SOC 2 Type II confirmed. No status change.

tools.name: Chroma
tools.oneLine: Confirmed maximum-severity remote-takeover flaw, still unpatched.
tools.best_for: Local prototyping only — use the Rust version, never expose to the internet.
tools.watch_out: An official advisory (CVE-2026-45829) rates a pre-login remote-takeover bug 10.0/10. Still unpatched as of the latest release (v1.5.9) — the vendor shipped a new version without fixing it. Use the Rust server; never expose the Python server to the internet.
tools.history: Human-verified 22 Jul 2026 (CVE-2026-45829, CVSS 10.0). Re-checked 11 Aug 2026: still unpatched — vendor released v1.5.9 (up from 1.5.8) but did not fix the flaw. Warning stands; re-checking until a patch ships.

tools.name: LlamaParse
tools.oneLine: Turns messy PDFs, scans and Office files into clean text.
tools.best_for: Reading documents reliably with no infrastructure.
tools.watch_out: No free self-host; HIPAA enterprise-only.
tools.history: Generous free tier verified. No status change.

tools.name: Reducto
tools.oneLine: Vision-first reader for the hardest files — tables, charts, handwriting.
tools.best_for: Complex, high-stakes documents where accuracy is everything.
tools.watch_out: No free self-host; accuracy scores are vendor-run.
tools.history: SOC 2, HIPAA and private deployment confirmed. Vendor-run benchmarks noted.

tools.name: Docling
tools.oneLine: Free, open-source, runs entirely on your own machine.
tools.best_for: Parsing documents privately and for free (needs some code).
tools.watch_out: Not turnkey; needs technical setup.
tools.history: Now under the Linux Foundation — governance risk lowered.

tools.name: Unstructured
tools.oneLine: The broadest range of file types, with dozens of source connectors.
tools.best_for: Pipelines ingesting many file types from many sources.
tools.watch_out: Use the newer 'Transform' connector; HIPAA not listed.
tools.history: Deprecated connector flagged; entry updated to the Transform connector.

tools.name: Stripe
tools.oneLine: An official agent toolkit and MCP server, from a heavily-audited processor.
tools.best_for: Handling real payments from a well-audited, widely-used processor.
tools.watch_out: Primarily lets an agent RECEIVE money; agent-spending (Treasury) is still in preview. Toolkit package names are mid-restructure.
tools.history: Published 22 Jul 2026 as the trusted anchor for Payments (PCI L1, SOC 2, ISO 27001).

tools.name: PayPal
tools.oneLine: Official toolkit + MCP across a huge network; does both directions.
tools.best_for: Sending and receiving across a huge global network.
tools.watch_out: A 2022 breach reportedly exposed some customers' Social Security numbers and drew a reported ~$2M New York regulator settlement. Python toolkit support still pending.
tools.history: Published as Caution: 2022 SSN breach and $2M NY fine on record.

tools.name: x402
tools.oneLine: Open HTTP micropayment protocol (Coinbase/Visa/Stripe-backed). Crypto only.
tools.best_for: HTTP-native micropayments between agents and services.
tools.watch_out: Crypto/stablecoin settlement only (no fiat yet). A reported signature-bypass advisory and a security scan flagging high-risk issues across many ecosystem projects; real demand still thin.
tools.history: Published as Caution: security-scan flags across the ecosystem; strong backing.
